exposure: maternal obesity (categorized by BMI: normal, 30-34.9 kg/m2, 35-39.9 kg/m2, >40 kg/m2)
cohort: The study included 310 women who gave birth at the Obstetrics and Gynaecology Department, Clinical Hospital Centre Zagreb in 2014, categorized by BMI.
finding: Obese pregnant women had significantly higher rates of gestational diabetes, preeclampsia, fetal macrosomia, and cesarian delivery compared to normal weight women.
mod_finding: Obese pregnant women had significantly higher rates of cesarian delivery.
